name: Befard XC400 glazing robot
summary: Compact radio-controlled wheeled glazing robot with four vacuum cups that lifts panes and windows of up to 400 kg to about 3.9 m height and sets them into openings. Made by Befard in Poland as the smallest of its wheeled glazing robots.

germany.statusNote: A new XC400.1 is listed on the German machinery marketplace Maschinensucher.de at a fixed price of €18,400 plus VAT, located at Befard's address in Kozy, Poland. Befard also names GreenLifter in Fürth as its sales partner for Germany; GreenLifter's own site does not list the XC400.

notes: Arm = hydraulic boom with a four-cup vacuum beam; options include hydraulic side shift and beam rotation (each reduces load by 100 kg), hook and forks.
Remote-controlled by an operator; not autonomous.
Maker says its wheeled glazing robots run on uneven ground without losing stability (roughGround is a maker claim).
Drive type and runtime are not stated on the pages read.
